title: Payment service unavailable
body: Checkout has been down since 9 AM, and no customers can complete their orders. Sales are stopped across all stores.
rationale: Widespread outage with immediate impact on orders

title: Possible data exposure
body: We found customer documents accessible through a public link. We need to block access and investigate immediately.
rationale: Privacy risk requiring immediate containment

title: Critical delivery delayed
body: The order contains equipment needed to keep the intensive care unit running. The hospital says its current supply runs out today.
rationale: Immediate operational risk to a critical service

title: Primary account compromised
body: I received login alerts I do not recognize, and my password was changed without my authorization. I can no longer access the account.
rationale: Possible active account compromise

title: Error blocking operations
body: After this morning's update, all operators get an error when printing labels. We have hundreds of shipments that must go out today.
rationale: Operational blockage with a same-day deadline

title: Transfer cancellation needed today
body: A high-value transfer was scheduled to the wrong account, and the bank says it can still be canceled until 2 PM today.
rationale: Imminent deadline to prevent significant financial loss

title: Production app inaccessible
body: The on-call team cannot access the production dashboard, and orders have been piling up for two hours.
rationale: Production outage with growing impact

title: Refrigeration failure
body: The warehouse sensor shows the temperature is out of range, and refrigerated products may spoil. The team is on site waiting for instructions.
rationale: Imminent risk of losing temperature-sensitive inventory

title: Essential service interrupted
body: Since an integration failed, no prescriptions are being sent to pharmacies. Patients need to pick up their medication today.
rationale: Essential service failure affecting patients today

title: Certificate expires in one hour
body: The production domain certificate expires at 4 PM, and automatic renewal failed. After that, customers may no longer be able to access the service.
rationale: Imminent outage risk with an explicit deadline

title: Duplicate amount on invoice
body: This month's invoice appears to include the installation fee twice. Could you check and send a corrected version?
rationale: Billing issue requiring review but with no immediate deadline or risk

title: Incomplete reports
body: The weekly reports are missing Tuesday's data. We can still access the data in the application, but the report needs to be fixed.
rationale: Functional issue with a temporary workaround

title: Request to amend contract
body: I would like to update the company's billing address for the next cycle. Could you tell me which documents are required?
rationale: Administrative request requiring follow-up

title: Occasional synchronization delay
body: Some contacts take about ten minutes to appear in the CRM after import. Work can continue, but this is causing duplicates.
rationale: Recurring issue with moderate and manageable impact

title: Refund still pending
body: The refund approved last week has not appeared on my statement yet. Could you confirm its status and expected timeline?
rationale: Financial follow-up request without immediate urgency

title: Error exporting history
body: History exports fail for periods longer than six months. Monthly exports work normally; we need help getting the annual file.
rationale: Feature is partially available and support is needed

title: Invitations not reaching some colleagues
body: Two team members did not receive their email invitations. We can continue with the other users, but need to complete their access.
rationale: Limited impact on a few users with a workaround

title: Request for scheduled maintenance
body: Could you schedule maintenance for the office printer this week? It still works, but it is making noise and needs to be checked.
rationale: Maintenance needed without total failure or immediate risk

title: Integration requires reauthorization
body: The calendar integration disconnects once a day and needs to be authorized again. Events remain available in the original calendar.
rationale: Recurring incident with an available workaround

title: Update company billing name before next invoice
body: The company has changed its trading name. Please update the billing profile before next week's invoice is issued so it shows the correct legal name.
rationale: Concrete billing change requested before the next invoice is issued

title: Support hours
body: Hello, what are your support hours during holidays?
rationale: Informational question with no operational impact or deadline

title: Plan information
body: Could you send a description of the available plans and included features?
rationale: General information request with no urgency

title: Receipt confirmation
body: I just wanted to confirm that you received the form I sent yesterday. There is no rush to reply.
rationale: Confirmation with no stated urgency

title: Tutorial for adding users
body: Is there a guide for adding a new user to the account? We are planning to do this next month.
rationale: How-to question about a future task

title: App availability
body: Does the application work on Android tablets, or is it only compatible with computers?
rationale: Simple compatibility question

title: Change notification format
body: Would it be possible to receive a weekly summary instead of individual notifications? This is just a preference for our team.
rationale: Preference suggestion with no impact on current operations

title: Old payment receipt
body: When you have a chance, could you resend the payment receipt from March?
rationale: Document request with no urgent deadline

title: Thanks for the support
body: Thanks for your help with the setup. The team has completed everything and it is working well.
rationale: Thank-you message with no pending action

title: Product demonstration meeting
body: We are evaluating tools for next quarter. Could we schedule a demonstration at a convenient time?
rationale: Future interest with no near-term deadline

title: Update mailing address for reference
body: Could you update the mailing address shown in the profile? It does not affect current invoices or deliveries.
rationale: Profile update with no immediate consequences
